findings.title: Sideloaded app with overlay and auto-start permissions
findings.whyFlagged: Application was sideloaded and holds both overlay and background auto-start privileges without a visible launcher icon.
findings.falsePositiveHint: Legitimate utility widgets may hold overlay permissions if configured by user.

evidence.title: Overlay Permission Granted
evidence.details: Application holds SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW with appop mode ALLOW

recommendedAction.title: Disable application com.example.mock.adware
recommendedAction.impact: Application will be frozen and cannot launch or display overlays
